obc.translation: abbr. outer back cover 封底; on board checkout 在板校验; oscillating Baffle column 振动挡板柱（塔）; old brutal convict 时间长而令人痛苦的肺病

obcompressed.definition:
a. Compressed or flattened antero-posteriorly, or in a
   way opposite to the usual one.

obconical.definition:
a. Conical, but having the apex downward; inversely
   conical.

obcordate.definition:
a. Heart-shaped, with the attachment at the pointed end;
   inversely cordate: as, an obcordate petal or leaf.

obcs.translation: abbr. object based control structure 基于对象的控制结构
